acceptance_rule: A new visitor can tell that ND Oracle contains things such as conditions, books, games and apps, and can reach them without first learning what “Resources”, “Topics”, “Needs” or similar internal categories mean.

first_decision_area.rule: The Home page presents one first decision only: six concrete visitor-recognisable routes. Search is a separate escape route; deeper browsing stays collapsed or secondary.

primary_categories.label: ADHD, autism & other neurodivergence
primary_categories.purpose: Learn about ADHD, autism and other kinds of neurodivergence.

primary_categories.label: Help with everyday life
primary_categories.purpose: School, work, communication, sensory needs, relationships and daily tasks.

primary_categories.label: Books, films & media
primary_categories.purpose: Stories and information about neurodivergent lives.

primary_categories.label: Find support
primary_categories.purpose: Groups, services, charities and other places to get help.

primary_categories.label: Ask a question
primary_categories.purpose: Not sure where to start? Begin with what is happening.

overlap_rules: Home navigation is a presentation layer, not the canonical content taxonomy.
One governed object may be reachable from more than one visitor route without cloning or reclassifying its authority.
The six Home routes do not require changes to canonical URLs, object categories, Claims, Evidence, discovery policy or ranking.
If a first-hop destination is confusing, repair only the demonstrated blocker; do not redesign unrelated destination architecture inside this tranche.

choices: Something to read, watch or use
Somewhere or someone that can help
uncertainty_route.rule: The existing /start/ route remains available for compatibility, but it is not another prominent Home decision set.

terminology_rule: Internal/system terms may remain as compatibility or specialist routes, but a new visitor must not need to understand them to reach ordinary content.
hierarchy_rule: Six primary Home routes → separate Search → collapsed secondary exploration → deeper/internal browsing tools.

direct_reachability.target_pattern: Home → clear first-hop route → item or next concrete choice
direct_reachability.avoidable_failure_pattern: Home → internal taxonomy term → catalogue → type → item
category_pages_require: clear route back to the six Home choices
wrong-choice recovery without restarting the journey

visual_rules: Use colour plus non-colour structure to separate meaningful sections.
Retain the readable base text size; use weight and hierarchy for importance.
Avoid whitespace that separates mutually dependent information.
The Home surface communicates content types before project explanation or methodology.
Recognition imagery is secondary to the category label and remains rights-gated.
imagery_rule: Render a cleared visual when it materially helps the user recognise, distinguish or understand the resource.
implementation_boundary: Presentation/navigation authority only: Home, minimal header/search, collapsed secondary exploration, first-hop aliases and the tests/evidence needed to validate them. Governed knowledge and production authority stay protected.

human_acceptance.first_question: Without clicking anything, what kinds of things do you think you can find on this website?
human_acceptance.label_check: For each primary heading, ask what the participant expects to find there before explaining the description.
representative_tasks: find a book about an autistic young person
find something that could help with starting tasks
find help with school or study
start when you do not know the correct term
recover after deliberately choosing the wrong first route
human_acceptance.rule: Automated tests and screenshots cannot satisfy the real-human gate; repair only demonstrated usability or accessibility problems, not aesthetic preference alone.

recovery_rule: No first choice becomes a dead end. A visitor can return to the six Home choices, use Search, or follow a clearly related route without restarting the journey.
scope_guard: This tranche changes Home, minimal header/search, collapsed secondary navigation and only the first-hop presentation routes needed by the six choices.
Do not restructure the wider ND Oracle taxonomy or canonical destination architecture unless human testing demonstrates a blocker.
Do not change governed content merely to make it fit a Home category.
Record unrelated destination or typography findings for a separate tranche.
mandatory_acceptance: Search is available separately and is not a seventh category card
only one primary classification system is visible on Home
secondary exploration is collapsed or visually subordinate by default
all six labels are understandable without teaching ND Oracle taxonomy
no repeated severe misrouting around the same label
representative tasks can be completed without facilitator guidance
no broken canonical route or protected-authority change
